description: This Java source file implements a service module for integrating VeriSign PayFlow Pro payment gateway with OFBiz, providing methods for processing, capturing, voiding, refunding payments, and handling PayPal express checkout flows.

classes.name: PayflowPro
classes.description: Service class providing payment processing methods for VeriSign PayFlow Pro integration, including credit card authorization, capture, void, refund, and PayPal express checkout handling.

methods.name: ccProcessor
methods.description: Processes a credit card payment through PayFlow Pro API, handling both regular and PayPal payments, and returns the response with authorization details.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Captures a previously authorized payment, supporting both credit card and PayPal transactions.

methods.name: ccVoid
methods.description: Voids a previously authorized or captured transaction.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Refunds a captured payment, supporting both credit card and PayPal transactions.

methods.name: setExpressCheckout
methods.description: Initiates a PayPal express checkout, requesting a checkout token and redirect URL.

methods.name: getExpressCheckout
methods.description: Completes the PayPal express checkout, creating a payment method and updating the cart.

methods.name: doExpressCheckout
methods.description: Finalizes the PayPal express checkout, executing the payment and updating payment method details.
